reviewMethod: Independent visual inspection of all 20 original paper pages and scheme PDF pages 29–60. All 47 published marking units retained; 60 mechanically generated menu routes and both parallel-pair routes give 107 cards. Publication follows the current one-card-per-printed-choice policy; legacy routes and source checks are retained in choice-policy.json.
sourceNotes: Candidate total is 300: Q1–7 plus either Q8A or Q8B and both Q9–10. All offered tasks total 325 before finite route expansion.
Paper 2 has different scale ladders from Paper 1. The PDF 46 table governs these cards. Exactly seven units are starred: Q7(b)(i–iii), Q8B(a), Q10(a)(ii), Q10(b)(ii), Q10(c).

Q2(b), Q2(c)(i–iii), Q3(c) retain one published scale each; all entries remain required. Q3(a) expands the Cartesian product of the printed 4 starters × 3 mains × 5 desserts, all with the shared 15C tariff.
Q8B(c) explicitly asks for one pair in the supplied parallelogram. Both possible parallel pairs are retained. Q1(a)(ii) asks for open descriptions of events, not a closed supplied pool.
Q4(e) model answer duplicates age 55: the original plot has one. A separate source clarification gives the correct 12 ages while retaining the SEC print.

The original blood percentages and menu spelling Vegetation curry are preserved. No medical assertion is made. Mathematical glyph criteria in Q3(b), Q5(b)(i), Q8B(b), Q10(b)(i) are retained visually in the complete printed notes.
Q8A construction, central symmetry and angle measurement retain the complete original template and prior construction context. Q7(b)(iii) carries both given lengths and the enlargement factor.
